segments_b.text: Today was the last, what would you do?
Would you chase the sunrise, paint the sky so blue?
Would you hold on tight, miss the words unsaid?
Break down the walls, you built in your head
Would you dance in the rain, feel every drop
Nothing till you couldn't stop, heart beats the harp
Would you call the ones you love
Love, so no more than enough, enough
Today was your last, wouldn't you be free?
Would you finally let yourself just be
Every heartbeat, every sigh
Would you live like you could touch the sky?
What you walk barefoot on the sand leave your mark hand in hand would you sing out loud no fear no shame feel the power in your name
Would you share a smile make someone stay give a little more in your own way would you see the beauty even in the pain
That is how we lived in vain
If it's your day, what's your last?
Would you be free?
Would you finally let yourself just be
Every heartbeat, every sigh
Would you be free?
